parameters.name: tube_w
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-34, D-54: aluminium tube 20 x 40 x 1.2; the 20 mm face carries the skin, so the 40 mm runs through the wall (outer_t = ACP 3 + frame 40). The joint register may turn it for the bond width (HOLD)

parameters.name: tube_d
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: frame depth = outer panel 46 - skin 3 - bond 3 = 40 (D-34)

parameters.name: tube_t
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-34, D-54, D-85: perimeter members (rails, front and back stiles) keep the 1.2 mm wall; they carry the rivnuts (grip check passed)

parameters.name: stud_t
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-85 (weight): intermediate studs at a 1.0 mm wall; they carry no rivnut, only the skin's bond line

parameters.name: stile_pitch_max
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-16, D-34: members 400 mm apart or less, to keep the ACP flat

parameters.name: pnl_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: D-49 depth 1495 less the 2.26 gap at the decor back plate (PM ruling on F-008): 1492.74

parameters.name: pnl_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: skeleton side_h: 2 sheets per side wall (D-23) with the seam gaps

parameters.name: skin_ret
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: back return of the side skin: covers the frame's back end at the corner, where the side skin covers the back panel's edge (D-55; sample drawing D04). V-groove and fold per the ACP maker (HOLD H16)

parameters.name: skin_setback
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: skin edge set back from the frame's top and bottom edges: 0, so the outside reveal equals the 2.26 seam gap (D-23: crisp, aligned reveals; joints register 2.8 leaves the setback to the WALL drawing)

parameters.name: frm_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the frame stops at the inside of the skin's back return

parameters.name: frm_h
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the frame fills the skeleton envelope height; seam and base gasket gaps are set by the joint register (HOLD)

parameters.name: corner_w
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: the side panel's back member is 40 x 40 x 1.2 (PM ruling on the joints register, item 3, 2026-10-31; register F2, FR-06): the back corner joint needs a 37+ mm overlap for the rivnut and the bolt

parameters.name: stile_n_mid
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: intermediate stiles so that no stile pitch (centre to centre) exceeds stile_pitch_max

parameters.name: stile_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: equal stile pitch, centre to centre, from the front stile to the 40 mm back stile

parameters.name: top_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: top member height: 20 on a lower panel; 40 x 40 on an upper panel, where the ceiling bolts in (PM ruling R-J3, joints register FR-06)

parameters.name: stile_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: stiles fit between the full-length rails (butt joints)

parameters.name: ceil_bolt_dz
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: J-CEIL-01 side bolts on the ceiling frame tube's centre: the skeleton's ceil_bolt_z, Z 2374 on P04 (joints register R-J15, FR-07)

parameters.name: fill_t
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: 40 mm PET fill fills the frame depth (D-34; layout study 40 mm)

parameters.name: bolt_d
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: PM ruling on F-009: bolt holes 7.0 (0.51 float), position tolerance 0.4 (+-0.2) from the spigot hole, CNC or drill jig (joints register FR-02)

parameters.name: access_d
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: register FR-03: passes the 18 mm head washer (ISO 7093-1, R-J10), the M6 head and the 5 mm key; holds the grommet retainer (H-02)

parameters.name: bolt_line_y
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: J-WALL-02 bolt line on the back panel's tube centre, Y 824 (joints register R-J15, FR-07)

parameters.name: rivnut_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAH3-610-4.2 hole 9.53 +0.10 (HW-SEL A5; register H-03)

parameters.name: spigot_d
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: register FR-05: hole for the 8 mm locating spigot H-05

parameters.name: spigot_slot
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: register FR-05: slot length for the second spigot

parameters.name: spigot_edge
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the skeleton's spigot_inset: spigots 100 from each end of the edge (PM ruling 2026-10-31, R-J13)

parameters.name: bolt_edge
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the skeleton's bolt_edge_inset: end bolts 220 in from the panel's ends, evenly spaced, every bolt 30 or more from any stile (PM ruling 2026-10-31, R-J14)

parameters.name: n_side_jnt
parameters.comment: SOURCE: register J-WALL-02, J-FRONT-01: 3 bolts up each side panel

parameters.name: side_jnt_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: equal pitch of the 3 bolts up the corner and decor joints

parameters.name: pocket_w
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: register FR-10: fill left out 60 x 60 next to each bolt for the key

parameters.name: corner_z0
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: bottom of the back panel row this side panel meets at the corner (B1/B2 or B3/B4, skeleton P04)

parameters.name: corner_bolt_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: J-WALL-02 bolts run along the back panel's edge: 220, 559.31, 898.61 on its 1118.61 (joints register 2.9)

parameters.name: n_len_bolt
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the skeleton's n_base_bolt (4): the same count on J-WALL-01 and the J-CEIL-01 side edges (register 2.9)

parameters.name: ceil_bolt_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: J-CEIL-01 side edge: 4 bolts along the ceiling's 1495 from Y -645 (its front edge), 220 rule, pitch 351.67 on P04; CEILING drills the same (PM ruling 2026-10-31 16:55; joints register 2.9)

parameters.name: len_bolt_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: even pitch of the bolts along the panel

parameters.name: felt_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: plan VT03-PET 9 mm PET felt; HW-SEL A3; D-31 (the factory's felt)

parameters.name: tray_t
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-37: galvanised steel tray 0.5 mm

parameters.name: tray_h
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: PM ruling 2026-10-31 (WALL group, option 1): the wall cassettes use the ceiling's tray, returns the full cassette depth (34) turned in as lips that hold the felt, no ribs; settles H09 for the walls

parameters.name: lip_w
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: PM ruling 2026-10-31 (WALL group, option 1): 12 mm lips hold the felt edge

parameters.name: bend_r
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: inside bend radius 1 x t for 0.5 mm DX51D (the sheet metal rule's bend radius is its Thickness); the factory's tooling sets it (guideline 9)

parameters.name: felt_c
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: felt edge clearance inside the returns, as the ceiling cassette

parameters.name: gap_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: air gap between the tray base and the felt (24): the acoustic gap (D-17) and the cable path (D-26)

parameters.name: cass_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: = 1448: from the decor back plate to past the back cassette's face, closing the inside corner (D-57)

parameters.name: cass_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: lower: the panel height; upper: stops lin_gap under the roof frame so it floats (D-57)

parameters.name: clip_zone_h
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: height of each reserved clip zone (H03: no clip named)

parameters.name: clip_zone_dz
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: clip zone centre from the cassette's top and bottom edges (H03)

parameters.name: stopw_od
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-08: stop washer Ø10.5 x Ø20 x 1.5 (PROPOSED part)

parameters.name: stopw_id
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-08

parameters.name: stopw_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-08: rivnut head 0.76 + washer 1.5 = the 2.26 stop (R-J5)

parameters.name: rivnut_head_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAH3-610-4.2 head Ø12.96 (joints register H-03, SHX)

parameters.name: rivnut_head_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAH3-610-4.2 head 0.76 ±0.08 (H-03, SHX)

parameters.name: rivnut_body_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAH3-610-4.2 body Ø9.50 max (H-03, SHX)

parameters.name: rivnut_len
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAH3-610-4.2 installed length 10.16 max under the head (H-03, SHX); the bulge inside the tube is not modelled

parameters.name: m6_d
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: M6 threads shown at their 6 mm major diameter (no modelled thread)

parameters.name: spigot_pin_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-05: Ø8 stainless pin (PROPOSED, assumption sizes)

parameters.name: spigot_proud
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-05: stands 8 proud (read as: of the joint face)

parameters.name: spigot_thread_l
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: M6 thread into the spigot rivnut; H-05 gives no length; 10 stays inside the rivnut's 10.16
